items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bill Bourgeois. And Florence, what's your name? You're taking pictures here. Florence, Florence.

ctx.x: It doesn't matter. Wilfred. Wilfred is your correct name. I've been called Bill ever since I was born, I guess.

Bill Bourgeois. And Florence, what's your name? You're taking pictures here. Florence, Florence. And I'm Dick Allen. Okay, let's see. We were just playing that Bosdell for a record of... Let's see, what was that? Waffle Man's Call? Waffle Man's Call. That's pretty old, isn't it? Yeah, 24, I think. And you said... That's about the year I started playing. Yeah, is that right? And you were saying he was good with the plunging music, huh?
Very, very good. He was excellent. And Skaggs, you say?
